parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the encryption parameter.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description: The share type of the encryption parameter.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. The decrypted parameter value is returned only if this parameter is set to true. Otherwise, null is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-secret-parameter-versions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --max-results 10 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ3NjFENDdB --share-type Private --with-decryption false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListSecretParameterVersions --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ3NjFENDdB --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --WithDecryption false --Name MySecretParameter --ShareType Private
